title: Star Names
scene: Connect stars on a dark sky chart to reveal a recognizable constellation.

title: Planet Pairs
scene: Turn over paired planet and moon cards on a small observatory desk.

title: Deflect!
lesson: Impulse: a small push early beats a big push late
scene: Apply a gentle early impulse to a comet so its projected orbit misses a protected station.

title: Lunar Lander
scene: Throttle a tiny lunar lander above a level landing pad with a visible fuel reserve.

title: Orbit Garden
scene: Adjust a planet's initial velocity in a simple orbital sandbox with traced ellipses.

title: Station Watch
scene: Compare delayed telescope readings on a calm orbital-station monitoring display.

title: Probe Workshop
lesson: Mass budgets, the rocket equation, sensors
scene: Assemble a probe from sensors, battery and thruster modules on a workbench.

title: Light-Lag Chess
scene: Send a move across a space-strategy board where a visible signal takes time to arrive.

title: Telescope Tour
scene: Explore a mapped star field through a telescope with distance-scale markers.

title: Solar Sail
lesson: Radiation pressure, slow but endless thrust
scene: Orient a thin solar sail so sunlight changes a probe's trajectory.

title: Satellite Network
scene: Connect satellites around a globe to cover isolated ground stations.

title: Rocket Builder
scene: Stage a small research rocket with a clear propellant and dry-mass cutaway.

title: Planet Maker
scene: Adjust a fictional planet's atmosphere and incoming sunlight using model controls.

title: Relativity Ride
scene: Compare clocks on a near-light-speed spacecraft and its home station.

title: Orbital Dock
scene: Align a small research capsule with a rotating station docking ring using tiny reaction-control puffs.

title: Debris Sweep
scene: Pilot a rescue drone through drifting debris, using gentle tractor-field arcs to clear paths for stranded probes.

title: Rover Geologist
scene: Drive a compact scientific rover to layered rock outcrops and compare a sample with instrument readings.
